title: New Outlook for Windows app data
whyItMatters: The Store version of Outlook keeps local configuration, cached web data and attachments. It shows that the account was signed into this PC.
source: Microsoft Learn, new Outlook profile and cache locations: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-apps/outlook/get-started/virtualized-desktop-infrastructure
notes: Microsoft also documents %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/olk for cache and attachments; that is a separate folder. Mail stays on the server; no content is parsed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any attachment or message you need from new Outlook first, because the local cache is all that is removed here.
cleanup.signOut: In new Outlook, open View > View settings, then Accounts > Your accounts, select Manage for the account, and choose Remove.
steps: Uninstall new Outlook for Windows from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Outlook package folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local cache, settings and downloaded attachments for new Outlook; the mail itself stays in the mailbox.
cleanup.source: Microsoft, Add an email account to Outlook for Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook/getstarted/add-an-email-account-to-outlook-for-windows
